behavior: A commit in the range whose Co-authored-by trailer names an AI agent fails the guard with the commit and trailer, in any key case and among human co-authors.
A human co-author, a mention in body prose, and a trailer only before base do not fail the guard.
The guard fails closed (exit 2) on a range it cannot resolve.
verification: bash scripts/tests/test-ai-trailers.sh && { bash scripts/check-ai-trailers.sh HEAD no-such-ref-ci358; test $? -eq 2; }

behavior: Repo hygiene runs the guard on pull requests over base.sha..head.sha and the suite under bash and zsh (CI-only: zsh is not required locally).
verification: awk '/name: Pull request commits carry no AI-attribution trailer/{s=1} s&&/if: github.event_name == .pull_request./{i=1} s&&/run: bash scripts\/check-ai-trailers.sh "\$BASE_SHA" "\$HEAD_SHA"/{r=1} /run: ATG_SHELLS=.bash zsh. bash scripts\/tests\/test-ai-trailers.sh/{t=1} END{exit !(i&&r&&t)}' .github/workflows/repo-hygiene.yml
